scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.db:setup: pnpm run db:up && pnpm run db:push && pnpm run db:seed
scripts.dev: tsx scripts/run-with-env.ts concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run dev" "pnpm --filter @workspace/mockup-sandbox run dev"
